description: Defaults for unattended runs. The owner overrides any of them once with `softory charter approve <file>` at a terminal; the result lives in local.json. Agents read it with `softory charter show` and never change it.

epics.description: Epics inside these limits start without the owner's go/no-go. Greg raises an escalation to the owner for anything bigger.

budget.description: Caps per role per day, in runs and minutes, so they hold whatever the model costs. Set for Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra; tune after a week of softory usage. roles overrides any cap for one role.

permissions.description: Claude Code runs each role with a settings file built from these and its lane paths. Commands are prefixes.

models.description: Per role: the default harness and model, and an optional stronger one used once a task has had escalate_model_after rounds of requested changes. Chosen on 2026-10-24 from benchmarks that fit each role's work; see docs/models.md.
